Security Analyst

About the role: we are hiring a Security Analyst to join our security operations team. Responsibilities: you will monitor, triage, and respond to threats across our estate. Requirements: several years of blue-team or SOC experience. Qualifications: strong knowledge of detection engineering and incident response. What you'll do: make attacks expensive and incidents short. What we offer: competitive compensation and a remote-friendly culture. Minimum qualifications: a track record of handling real incidents.
